commands.name: new
commands.description:
Create a new EasyAF solution with Core, Data, Business, Api,
MessageBus, and Tests projects.

options.name: --output
options.description:
The folder to create the solution in. Defaults to the current
folder.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The root namespace for the projects. Defaults to <name>.

options.name: --framework
options.description:
The .NET version to target: 10 or 11 (default).
Default value is: 11.

options.name: --no-api
options.description: Don't create the Api project or its tests.

options.name: --no-messagebus
options.description:
Don't create the MessageBus.Core, MessageBus.Dispatch, or
MessageBus.Runtime projects.

options.name: --no-runtime
options.description: Don't create the MessageBus.Runtime project.

options.name: --webjob
options.description:
Add Azure WebJob publish settings to the MessageBus.Runtime
project.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description:
The solution name, for example CloudNimble.Contoso. Also the
root namespace unless --namespace is set.
